key_impacts: Nuclear fuel inside reactors melted due to the accident.
Large volumes of highly contaminated water accumulated and are stored in onsite tanks.
Complete decontamination is described as impossible, indicating long-term environmental contamination.
Significant disruption to residents’ daily lives and communities, requiring rebuilding.
Food safety concerns affecting agriculture, forestry and fisheries, requiring measurement and information disclosure.
evidence_snippets: A large-scale nuclear disaster at TEPCO’s Fukushima Daiichi plant, directly caused by the March 11, 2011 earthquake and tsunami.
Operators cool the nuclear fuel that melted inside the nuclear reactors due to the accident.
The site has been packed with tanks containing contaminated water as groundwater flows in daily.
missing_information: No casualty or displacement numbers provided.
Offsite affected towns/areas are not enumerated here.
